task_completion.description: Agent opens and reads the IT Change Request document on the desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the content of 'hris_globalization_directive.txt'.

task_completion.description: Timezone and Date Format are updated to the specified European standards.
task_completion.visual_evidence: HRMS settings page showing Timezone set to 'Europe/Berlin' and Date Format set to 'DD/MM/YYYY'.

task_completion.description: Password security rules (length and expiry) are updated in the security settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Security/Password configuration screen showing Minimum Length as '12' and Password Expiry as '90' days.

task_completion.description: The Assets module is specifically disabled or deactivated.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Module management or App settings screen showing the 'Assets' module toggled off or marked as inactive.

task_completion.description: The Expenses module is specifically disabled or deactivated.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Module management or App settings screen showing the 'Expenses' module toggled off or marked as inactive.

task_completion.description: Core modules other than Assets and Expenses remain active.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Module list showing other modules (e.g., Payroll, Employees, Recruitment) remain enabled/active while Assets and Expenses are disabled.

integrity.description: The agent used the HRMS web interface/GUI to perform changes rather than direct database manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with buttons, dropdowns, and text fields within the HRMS application.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the settings menus rather than just searching for a success message.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots showing the navigation path (e.g., Settings -> Localization, Settings -> Security).

integrity.description: The agent did not use terminal scripts to bypass the UI for the configuration steps.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal is used only for reading the directive or initial setup, not for executing SQL or API commands to change settings.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The required configurations are: Timezone: Europe/Berlin; Date Format: DD/MM/YYYY; Minimum Password Length: 12; Password Expiry: 90 days. The modules 'Assets' and 'Expenses' must be deactivated, while all other modules must remain active.
